pr.title: Record the agent-messages check run after merge
pr.head: 6892aec90e12e946eb5438c1ade73b0aa9e26f80

summary: Projector lets agent sessions discover each other and exchange messages, on one machine or through encrypted Git refs between machines. The completed plan left a real-session check for after the merge.

This change records that check’s reported results: messaging and replies worked, delivered message refs and closed-session presence refs were removed, and idle sessions and relay pushes started no unexpected work. It also records one unexplained daemon exit as a follow-up.

cards.title: Documentation only
cards.html: The change adds a dated result to the completed plan. It changes no runtime code, project status, or section numbering.

cards.title: Review validation
cards.html: The configured gate and exact-head CI passed. Project metadata is valid. The review did not repeat the manual session check.

groups.title: Record the deferred check’s result
groups.kicker: The completed plan gains its manual validation outcome
intro: The plan’s acceptance criteria asked for real Claude Code and Codex sessions to wake and reply, then for two machines to exchange messages through a disposable repository. Section 11 now records the reported check and its cleanup observations.
A daemon exited without a stop log during the check. The record keeps that limitation visible and identifies orderly idle-exit cleanup as a possible follow-up; it does not change the implementation.

files.note: Section 11 gains the dated check result while preserving the completed plan’s design and status.

checks.text: The completed plan explicitly deferred this check in its outcome, and the repository permits recording that result after merge. Project validation passes and the status remains completed.
The daemon-exit observation is reported by the manual check. This review did not reproduce that exit; relay code confirms a one-hour presence lease and expiry cleanup.
